platformHelp.title: Help Guide
platformHelp.defaultHelp1: Go to the About page and click the Copy button next to Software Info
platformHelp.defaultHelp2: Contact the developer for assistance and provide the copied info
platformHelp.neteaseHelp1: This usually indicates audio device configuration issues
platformHelp.neteaseHelp2: Click 'Auto Detect' on the General settings page and follow the guide
platformHelp.neteaseHelp3: If problem persists, contact the developer for assistance
platformHelp.qqHelp1: Upgrade QQ Music to the latest version
platformHelp.qqHelp2: Check if 'Show SMTC' is enabled in QQ Music settings; this must be enabled
platformHelp.kugouHelp1: Check if 'Support system playback controls' is enabled in Kugou settings
platformHelp.appleHelp1: In current mode, target recognized platform is Cider 1.6.3
platformHelp.appleHelp2: To recognize native Apple Music, enable 'Prefer SMTC'
platformHelp.appleHelp3: To use Cider 1.6.3, please follow the video tutorial for configuration
platformHelp.mieboHelp1: View Miebo request plugin user guide
platformHelp.mieboHelp2: Ensure 'Enable browser source' is checked in Miebo settings
platformHelp.aynaHelp1: Open Ayna Player settings and select WebSocket Server in the sidebar
platformHelp.potplayerHelp1: For SMTC detection, ensure PotPlayer is version 240618 or higher
platformHelp.potplayerHelp2: Open PotPlayer Options and enable 'Use system media transport controls'
platformHelp.aimpHelp1: For SMTC detection, install plugin for AIMP following the illustrated guide
